2014_spells.wall-of-sand.description: You conjure up a wall of swirling sand on the ground at a point you can see within range. The wall is 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick. It blocks line of sight but not movement.
2014_spells.wall-of-sand.effectSummary: Summon a creature to fight for you for the duration
2014_spells.wall-of-sand.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you conjure up a wall of swirling sand on the ground at a point you can see within range. The wall is 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick; It blocks line of sight but not movement. The effect lasts for concentration, up to 10 minutes.
